Подумать только, он проведёт ночь в дилижансе!", "source_sha256": "d3ead95c38a28a745c86050b3ee950071123ff38322eb144526c4d5511985d04", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u175-r0031", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "89a9cb39b42a88a4ce8b325623e1cf6be38ad202b338021c5c72404c5d1e0f8a"}], "source_language": "French", "part": 3, "book": 3, "chapter": 7, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr81-u175-r0032", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Comme moi.", "sha256": "75b2906367f579daf68e2d36ec230757585398e5c10d32198584a2fab0c9f506", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u175-r0033", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Mais toi, c’est par devoir ; lui, c’est par désordre.", "sha256": "060c1e69eb609a9d2d30ce14c19dc1f5ecf4be4bce4d73875ec67212897eccfb", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u175-r0034", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Bigre ! fit Théodule.", "sha256": "387b0bc7a8c01c09b812dc2f398858bcd481ff0fdbb557bb5b82b1ea9080e9da", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u175-r0035", "tag": "prose", "text": "Ici, il arriva un événement à Mlle Gillenormand aînée ; elle eut une idée. Si elle eût été homme, elle se fût frappé le front. Elle apostropha Théodule :", "sha256": "1075fbe8c0c20a61d8ed86e87d101c1c86e03d65dee933751fefe4bf2ec8ecff", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u175-r0036", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Sais-tu que ton cousin ne te connaît pas ?", "sha256": "b69d0bddb553fca9fa09cd34a587eb7b7e479d84c4313691c01ff443d1d1814a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u175-r0037", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Non. Je l’ai vu, moi ; mais il n’a jamais daigné me remarquer.", "sha256": "739bfd8b58749e3c73389e6857cee97d5ca87adfe1404ed8ec6125392b20c6bf", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u175-r0038", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Vous allez donc voyager ensemble comme cela ?", "sha256": "990b4fd02296876b9be73f9d8c967667531cb6554d850b459e000c379fd874ff", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u175-r0039", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Lui sur l’impériale, moi dans le coupé.", "sha256": "3d94365a0acdfe3fa3773802ea86bb9bf1c428d77942cc49efd9cf49f7e6aeba", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u175-r0040", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Où va cette diligence ?", "sha256": "5070c57b926cb15f02339a58adaf17d859030256cc0b4298f9efaecfbda1f43a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u175-r0041", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Aux Andelys.", "sha256": "725c84905a8305958a93853c6cba4ae91dcc41699b9f9d3bb86e11a6b8fe3047", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u175-r0042", "tag": "prose", "text": "— C’est donc là que va Marius ?", "sha256": "0c5a4fd00fc9b70c39641b274af5f1b0fdef62cfa6ee2d958bea5a8853c75599", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u175-r0043", "tag": "prose", "text": "— À moins que, comme moi, il ne s’arrête en route. Moi, je descends à Vernon pour prendre la correspondance de Gaillon. Je ne sais rien de l’itinéraire de Marius.", "sha256": "fa1cc9c5db5e38ccc07f2e44322a69a6bbb2d8503eddf74e49b048d604e360ab", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u175-r0044", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Marius ! quel vilain nom ! Quelle idée a-t-on eue de l’appeler Marius ! Tandis que toi, au moins, tu t’appelles Théodule !", "sha256": "3b6f45262130e7f51bf7521c565bd093795db8fe82c1a0388fae4fd52df531af", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u175-r0045", "tag": "prose", "text": "— J’aimerais mieux m’appeler Alfred, dit l’officier.", "sha256": "fa44faa08dcada776755e35528b6485b42419bac803946a207bba23b0faa9028", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u175-r0046", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Écoute, Théodule.", "sha256": "50091822f9a2b06950f80f2c62172096514db8da04d99758645ebbb3d76e4188", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u175-r0047", "tag": "prose", "text": "— J’écoute, ma tante.", "sha256": "e0aacb8fc32141ec919093c6e1a340cd270ff4946e3f5ec280497dba7dd96f90", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u175-r0048", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Fais attention.", "sha256": "b46258e74a84e839df43d11d7c962e8880a0aa0d6928ded0dd43e86957e82032", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u175-r0049", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je fais attention.", "sha256": "abd3bbb8778bc376084c29ad3d079503fc630078ee6a093a72bf21955f52c5f1", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u175-r0050", "tag": "prose", "text": "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u175-r0053", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Eh ! eh !", "sha256": "e2e9270cef431de0fcf490e29d1720bcc3a7360881308269ea1909a8b15e4180", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u175-r0054", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Il voyage.", "sha256": "0c23ccf6c150b2369a82725119cb16909cbb9542729b31f03f1a8af98e1a5882", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u175-r0055", "tag": "prose", "text": "tag": "prose", "text": "— Il découche.", "sha256": "20c990700d14a4265f77239a8981b6fc812031ba0bab0eef35ac50479b58ace2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u175-r0057", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oh ! oh !", "sha256": "642f9889c7af94ef96a61b2d028a2ccfaf44b42db18b573d9b3103a87433b915", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u175-r0058", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Nous voudrions savoir ce qu’il y a là-dessous.", "sha256": "Théodule répondit avec le calme d’un homme bronzé :", "sha256": "e751279d390e97ae463b9833f82fe7f430b1d516598b3fb412ff906a88b4a079", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0,
